context.description: Step 01: Design the ENV-04 UI changes — persistent test-tenant banner, confirmation modal for promotion, tenant switcher labels.

task.description:
Produce a design artefact for ENV-04 (UI clearly labels test tenants and blocks accidental production actions) at src/design/env04-test-tenant-ui.md.

Before writing, read:
- The full ENV-04 requirement (docs/requirements.yaml or python tools/reqctl.py show ENV-04)
- The existing web/src/ structure to understand the frontend codebase
- ENV-01/ENV-02/ENV-03 related implementations to understand how tenant_type field and promotion API are already implemented
- SH-01 and SH-03 related UI (shell navigation, role-aware navigation) if present

The design must cover all ENV-04 acceptance criteria:
1. Persistent banner on every page when tenant_type='test': text 'TEST ENVIRONMENT' + paired production tenant name
2. Confirmation modal before 'Promote to Production': exact modal text specified in the requirement
3. No banner on production tenants
4. Admin tenant switcher: [TEST] suffix + visual distinction for test tenants
5. Instance list on test tenant: only shows test tenant instances (no production data)
6. 'Promote to Production' button only on Process Definition detail when tenant is test + definition status is ACTIVE

Design must specify:
- Which React components to create or modify
- Where to read tenant_type from (likely from the current session/user context already fetched)
- How to conditionally render the banner (layout component, not per-page)
- The exact text for the banner and confirmation modal
- Edge cases: mobile viewport (banner fixed, not collapsible), user has access to both tenants (reflects current session only)

Classify per templates/lego-catalog.md. The design MUST NOT contain TypeScript implementation code.

result.summary: Design for ENV-04 test-tenant UI (Type E). REWORK(1/3): split DFD fenced block (57 lines) into three blocks of ≤40 lines each with prose headings. lint_design_artefact.py exits 0.
